item.text: I’m collecting new 3B evidence families beyond the retained protest, siege, and displacement sources, focusing on direct domestic-safety mechanisms, accountability, and ruler-attribution in 2022. First pass is source discovery and deduping; I’ll then open the strongest items and only keep sources that add a distinct claim.
